info.title: Transmit SMS Fast API
info.description: API for sending SMS messages quickly with Transmit SMS.

post.description: Sends an SMS message using the fast API endpoint.

message.description: Define the content of the message (up to 612 alphanumeric characters).

to.description:
Set recipient number in international format. You can use the countrycode parameter to format numbers not in international format.

Examples:
- Australia: 61491570156
- New Zealand: 64212670129
- United Kingdom: 44750017696
- United States: 12513551145

countrycode.description:
Format the 'to' number in international format. Uses a 2-letter country code to transform a number from local to international format for reliable delivery. E.g., 0422222222 will become 61422222222 when countrycode is AU.

Examples:
- AU (Australia)
- NZ (New Zealand)
- GB (United Kingdom)
- US (United States)

from.description: Set the Sender ID. If no value is set, this defaults to the dedicated virtual number that is in your account. If no dedicated number is available, then the default sender ID for that country is used, if available.

send_at.description: Schedule a message at a specific time. Must be in ISO8601 format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS utilizing UTC Timezone. E.g., 2020-04-27 06:00:00.

smsfast_callback_url.description: Send an API response to a callback URL. This URL will receive notifications about your API call response. Parameters appended to the URL include message_id, send_at, recipients, cost, and sms.

dlr_callback.description: Send a delivery notification to a callback URL. This URL will receive notifications about delivery receipts. Parameters appended to the URL include message_id, mobile, datetime, status, and user_id.

reply_callback.description: Send a reply notification to a callback URL. This URL will receive notifications about incoming messages. Parameters appended to the URL include user_id, rate, mobile, response, message_id, response_id, longcode, datetime_entry, and is_optout.

validity.description: Expire a message send if undeliverable. Specify the maximum time to attempt to deliver in minutes. 0 (zero) or not set implies maximum validity period. Messages that remain in a PENDING state will be expired automatically after 72 hours. If a message is not delivered and not failed it is given a PENDING status in the system. These messages can be requested to be expired by the carrier after a certain time. This will return a DLR with a soft-bounce value. A PENDING state can exist for several reasons. Eg. Recipient handset out of range or switched off.

replies_to_email.description: Send reply to nominated email address. Specify an email address to send responses to this message. Email will come from the email address <to-number>@transmitsms.com (e.g., 0438333061@transmitsms.com). NOTE: If expectation is for replies to this email to be returned to the recipient as SMS, then the email address must be authorized to send messages in your account under the 'EMAIL SMS' section. Emails can also be authorized using the add-email call.
